quote: Except when traffic is being controlled by a police officer or a traffic-control signal: The driver of a vehicle shall stop in obedience to a stop sign or yield in compliance with a yield sign, in compliance with the manner prescribed in subsection 1 [NRS-484B-257-1], prior to entering an intersection if a stop sign or a yield sign is erected at one or more entrances thereto although not a part of a through highway and shall proceed cautiously, yielding to vehicles not so obligated to stop or yield and which are within the intersection or approaching so closely as to constitute an immediate hazard during the time such driver is moving across or within the intersection.

activation.condition: subject approaches an intersection on an entrance with a stop or yield sign outside a through highway

obligation.description: stop or yield before entry as prescribed, then proceed cautiously and yield to non-obligated vehicles within or immediately approaching the intersection

exceptions.trigger: traffic controlled by police officer or traffic-control signal
exceptions.effect: the sign-governed duty in this subsection does not apply during that control
exceptions.replacement_obligation: follow applicable officer or signal control after separate review
exceptions.source_clause: Except when traffic is being controlled by a police officer or a traffic-control signal:

timing.description: before entering and during movement across or within the intersection

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: properly erected sign and non-through-highway status
judgment_calls_needed.note: Official sign governance, affected entrance and roadway classification require independent source review.
Original other-vehicle approach and crossing interval require source review without a speed surrogate.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: proceed cautiously and yield throughout crossing
judgment_calls_needed.note: Original ego motion and body occupancy require independent judgment across the encounter.
